A book-length case for reforming UK taxes and benefits, written with Gordon Styles in 2020. Its fourteen chapters run from the ideas behind taxation and the principles of a good tax system to welfare and work, inequality, corporations, land and property, money and debt, and the environment, and end with a set of proposals.

**Download:** [The whole book (pdf)](../../../papers/Plucked.pdf)

*The views expressed are the authors' own.*
